# search text fixtures

Derived outputs only. Generated by running the pinned FVOCI TypeScript
functions (`packages/search/src/stem.ts`, `chosung.ts`, `normalizeSearchText`)
and npm `stemmer@2.0.1` (original Porter, MIT, Titus Wormer).

| File | Oracle | Count |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `porter_stems.tsv` | `stemmer(word)` and `stemText(word)` over the public-domain ENABLE word list (`enable1.txt`) | 172823 words |
| `stem_text.json` | `stemText` on mixed Korean/English/emoji/number sentences | 74 |
| `chosung.json` | `toChosung` and `isChosungQuery` | 44 |
| `normalize.json` | `normalizeSearchText` (NFKC) | 22 |

Do not treat these files as source implementations.
